import sys
from collections import Counter

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read()
    if not s:
        return
    s = s.strip()
    freq = Counter(s)
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for ch in s:
        if freq[ch] > 1 and ch not in seen:
            seen.add(ch)
            result.append(ch)
    sys.stdout.write(' '.join(result))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
